remarks: Experience luxury living in this elegant condo at Eastside Commons, conveniently located just steps from shops and restaurants. This two-bedroom, two-bath unit features an open floor plan with high ceilings and LVP flooring. The chef's kitchen is equipped with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and an island breakfast bar. The primary bedroom boasts an en-suite bath, walk-in closet and access to the private balcony, while the second bedroom also features a walk-in closet. For your convenience, a full-size washer and dryer are included within the unit. This pet-friendly building offers outstanding amenities, including concierge service, a fitness room, an outdoor courtyard complete with grills and tables, plus garage parking! Enjoy this carefree lifestyle in a prime location!
